verdict.rationale: Reflect documents official Chrome and Safari extensions for bookmarking websites and capturing snippets from across the web, with the link and highlights automatically added to the daily note. This covers the core official browser capture flow for pages and highlights, and the API also exposes bookmarked links. missing for 10: evidence of full-article or full-page content clipping (beyond bookmark plus snippets), control over which note captures land in (they go to the daily note), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extensions.
